title: Farls da bag · home page
question: Choose the visual direction for all-time history. Preview records are synthetic.

options.label: The league media guide
options.lineage: Team-issued football media guides and statistical indexes
options.thesis: A continuous record index puts the league's best and worst seasons in print.
options.viewport: The league masthead opens straight into large achievement and disaster entries, with a record-book index and recent history below.
options.risk: Dense index entries need careful ordering on a phone.

raised.raise: Use color only to distinguish active scope and exceptional records.
Keep each exhibit, its metric, and its source aligned through the whole page.
Make the page one coherent surface with one dominant opening.
Let visitors compare multiple records together without a carousel.
Reveal deeper history through a clear sequence of linked evidence.

options.label: Sunday broadcast
options.thesis: A broadcast record slate gives achievements and disasters equal billing.
options.viewport: One stacked all-time record slate leads to the record book, followed by the current archive.
options.risk: Familiar sports presentation can feel like another statistics site.

options.label: The league fan page
options.thesis: A proudly personal fan page treats league records as shared obsession.
options.viewport: One devoted column opens with a record wall, direct section links, and the start of the next exhibit.
options.case: Holds audience identification through league devotion; the media guide makes dense records clearer.
options.risk: Retro decoration can compete with evidence and mobile reading.

options.label: Cloud edge
options.thesis: Season records appear as bands that open their supporting results.
options.viewport: A spectrum of record bands resolves into the underlying season table.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity; atmospheric bands give no familiar route into football history.
options.kept: Disciplined color that marks meaningful distinctions.
options.risk: Visitors must learn an unrelated visual metaphor.

options.label: Daylight section
options.thesis: A continuous section connects each season's rooms to its records.
options.viewport: Seasons occupy connected bays with record annotations and source links.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity; architectural navigation slows access to records.
options.kept: A continuous alignment system linking content and evidence.
options.risk: The page requires reading an architectural diagram first.

options.label: Floating pigment
options.thesis: Each historical result forms a distinct pool within one continuous archive.
options.viewport: A marbled record field opens the exact results behind a selected pool.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity; fluid navigation obscures stable categories.
options.kept: One coherent surface and one dominant focal move.
options.risk: The visual action can overshadow the record itself.

options.label: VU bridge
options.thesis: Parallel manager channels compare results before opening their history.
options.viewport: A sweep of manager channels shows rate metrics with sample sizes.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity; instrument channels narrow the opening to rate comparisons.
options.kept: Simultaneous comparison across a whole set of records.
options.risk: Meter scales can imply comparisons the domain does not support.

options.label: Torn billboard
options.thesis: Older seasons sit beneath newer layers of league history.
options.viewport: An exposed all-time record opens a lower season layer and its source.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity; partial layers hide the clear record-book entrance.
options.kept: Depth that earns each step through linked historical evidence.
options.risk: Tearing can become a barrier to finding a fact.

canonCard.label: The conventional record book
canonCard.thesis: A familiar sports archive with featured records and direct navigation.
canonCard.viewport: Featured all-time records lead into an exhibit grid and recent updates.
canonCard.risk: The league's identity relies almost entirely on its content.
